spans.s:
उद् (properly acc. sing. n. of उ, probably an obsolete pronominal base, akin to व in अव, एव, etc.), a prefix, उप्, ओउत्.
 I. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives, q. cf.
 II. Former part of comp. nouns, e. g. उद्-अयुध, adj. With raised weapon (literally, having a weapon upward),

.
 उत्पक्ष्मन्, i. e. उद्-, adj. The eye-lids of which are elevated, Śāk. d. 90.
 उद्-दाम, adj. Unfettered (literally, having the fetter out),

.
 --Cf. ὕστερος, ὕστατος for [] ὑδ + τερο, τατο; Goth. and A.S. ut; O.H.G. ûz.
